name: Brand strategy
summary: Brand positioning, audience clarity, messaging, and a strategic foundation for your next chapter.
metaDescription: Brand strategy from Brandingdex: positioning, audience clarity, and messaging that give your identity and website a clear reason behind every decision.
headline:
Find your
*direction.*
lead: Before the logo, the website, or the campaign, there is a simpler question: what should people understand about you? Brand strategy answers it—and gives every design decision a clear reason behind it.
forTitle: For businesses at a turning point.

for.title: You are preparing to launch.
for.text: You have the idea and the offer. You need a clear way to explain it before investing in design.

for.title: You have outgrown your first positioning.
for.text: The business has changed, but the way you describe it has not caught up.

for.title: Your message changes from place to place.
for.text: Your website, social profiles, and pitch each tell a slightly different story.

includedTitle: A foundation you can build on.

included.title: Discovery
included.text: A structured conversation about your business, your audience, and your ambitions.

included.title: Audience clarity
included.text: Who you serve, what they need, and what they need to hear from you.

included.title: Competitor review
included.text: How others in your space present themselves—and where you can stand apart.

included.title: Positioning
included.text: A clear statement of what you offer, for whom, and why it matters.

included.title: Messaging
included.text: Key messages and a tone of voice your team can actually use.

included.title: Strategic foundation
included.text: A concise summary that guides your identity, website, and content decisions.

packagesNote: Strategy is built into Brand Signature, alongside a complete visual identity. Need positioning and messaging on their own? Ask for a tailored scope.

faq.q: Do I need strategy before a logo?
faq.a: Not always. Brand Essentials and Brand Identity begin with a discovery step that gives the design a clear direction. A fuller strategy phase helps most when you are launching something new, repositioning, or finding that your message changes from place to place.

faq.q: Can I get strategy on its own?
faq.a: Yes. Positioning and messaging can be scoped as a standalone project and quoted around your requirements. Tell us what you need in your project brief.
It depends on the scope. As part of Brand Signature, strategy and the complete identity are estimated at 4–6 weeks together. Your proposal confirms the timeline before work begins.

name: Brand identity design
summary: Logo systems, brand guidelines, business stationery, and visual assets that feel unmistakably yours across every touchpoint.
metaDescription: Brand identity design from Brandingdex: logo systems, colour, typography, brand guidelines, and business stationery. Clear packages from $350.
headline:
An identity that is
unmistakably *yours.*
lead: A logo is one piece. A brand identity is the whole system—marks, colour, typography, and the everyday materials that make your business recognisable wherever it shows up.
forTitle: For every stage of the business.

for.title: You are starting out.
for.text: You need a clear, professional identity from day one—without overbuilding.

for.title: You are growing.
for.text: You are ready for a consistent identity across your website, social media, and documents.

for.title: You are entering a new chapter.
for.text: A new offer, a new audience, or a new name deserves a deeper brand foundation.

includedTitle: A complete system, not a single file.

included.title: Logo system
included.text: A primary logo with alternate, secondary, and icon marks, so your brand works at every size.

included.title: Colour & typography
included.text: A defined palette and type system that make every piece feel related.

included.title: Brand guidelines
included.text: Clear rules and examples, so anyone on your team can apply the identity correctly.

included.title: Business stationery
included.text: Business cards, letterheads, invoice templates, and envelopes in selected packages.

included.title: Social templates
included.text: Editable layouts that keep your posts consistent without starting from scratch.

included.title: Logo animation
included.text: A simple 3–5 second logo animation, included in Brand Signature.

faq.q: How many logo directions will I see?
faq.a: Brand Essentials develops one logo direction, refined together with you. Brand Identity begins with two initial identity directions, and one is developed into the final system.
Brand Essentials and Brand Identity include two consolidated revision rounds. Brand Signature includes three. Additional rounds are quoted separately and agreed before work.
We design it and supply print-ready PDF files, with editable source files where applicable. Printing and physical production are separate.

faq.q: Can you refresh an existing brand?
faq.a: Yes. Share what you have and what is no longer working. We will recommend whether a refresh or a new identity makes more sense, and scope it in your proposal.

name: Website design
summary: Business websites, portfolio sites, landing pages, and responsive UX/UI—designed to turn your brand into a clear, professional online experience.
metaDescription: Website design and build from Brandingdex: landing pages and business websites that are responsive, clear, and ready for search. Packages from $500.
headline:
A website that makes
you easy to *choose.*
lead: Your website is often the first real conversation someone has with your business. We design and build responsive websites that make what you do clear, look unmistakably yours, and give every visitor an obvious next step.
forTitle: For one page or a full site.

for.title: You need one focused destination.
for.text: A landing page for a personal brand, a campaign, or a new offer.

for.title: You run a service business.
for.text: A polished multi-page website with room to tell your story and explain what you do.

for.title: You have more to say.
for.text: Richer content, a considered visitor journey, and a collection for work, articles, or services.

included.title: UX/UI design
included.text: Page layouts tailored to your brand and built around what your visitors need to find.

included.title: Responsive build
included.text: A website that looks and works properly on phones, tablets, and desktops.

included.title: Contact & enquiries
included.text: Contact form setup and social links, so interested visitors can reach you.

included.title: Search foundations
included.text: Page titles, descriptions, and indexing setup, so search engines can understand your site.

included.title: Analytics
included.text: Analytics setup, so you can see how people find and use your website.

included.title: Handover & fixes
included.text: Editable content setup, a clear handover, and a bug-fix period after launch.

faq.q: What is separate from website pricing?
faq.a: Domain registration, hosting, paid plugins, platform subscriptions, stock assets, copywriting, and ongoing maintenance are separate unless your proposal includes them. E-commerce and custom apps require a tailored quote.

faq.q: What do I need to provide?
faq.a: Your goals, feedback, and approved website text and imagery. Website-only packages assume you already have a usable brand identity. Content support can be added to your quote.
Yes. If you already have a developer, ask for a UX/UI-only scope. The listed website packages include design and build; standalone design is quoted around your requirements.

faq.q: I need a brand and a website. Where do I start?
faq.a: Brand + Website combines Brand Identity and Business Website under one creative direction and one coordinated delivery process, from $1,750.

name: Ongoing design support
summary: Campaign creative, logo animation, and ongoing design support to keep your brand consistent as the business grows.
metaDescription: Creative Partner from Brandingdex: monthly design support for social assets, presentations, campaign creative, and website updates. From $650 per month.
headline:
Keep moving
*forward.*
lead: A brand is not finished at launch. Creative Partner gives you consistent design support for the work that keeps coming—social assets, presentations, campaign creative, and website updates—without starting from scratch each time.
forTitle: For teams with steady design needs.

for.title: You publish regularly.
for.text: Social content, presentations, and campaigns need to look like they come from the same business.

for.title: You have no in-house designer.
for.text: You want reliable design capacity without hiring for a full-time role.

for.title: You want to stay consistent.
for.text: As more people create materials, someone needs to keep the brand held together.

included.title: 12 design hours a month
included.text: A set amount of design time, reserved for your business each month.

included.title: Everyday design
included.text: Social assets, presentations, and website updates, produced in your brand.

included.title: Campaign creative
included.text: Visuals for launches, promotions, and announcements as they come up.

included.title: Weekly priorities
included.text: We agree what matters most each week, with one active request at a time.

packagesNote: Creative Partner works best once you have a brand identity in place. Starting from scratch? Begin with a brand identity package.

faq.a: The partnership renews monthly, and unused hours do not roll over. Weekly priorities help make sure your hours go to the work that matters most.
Revisions count toward your monthly hours, so you decide how the time is best spent.
Monthly creative support is paid at the start of each month. Your proposal sets the final terms.
